codes.loop.help:
ℹ️ **Repeating tasks with `/loop`:**

• `/loop <interval> <prompt>`: run a prompt on a schedule (for example `/loop 30s check the status` or `/loop every 10 minutes summarize`)
• `/loop list`: show this conversation's repeating task
• `/loop stop`: stop this conversation's repeating task (the stop button at the top stops it too)
codes.loop.none_active: ℹ️ No repeating task is running in this conversation.
codes.loop.nothing_to_stop: ℹ️ There is no repeating task to stop.
codes.loop.registered:
🔄 **Repeating task started** (every {interval}, ID: `{job_id}`):
"{prompt}"

*To stop it, type `/loop stop` or press the stop button at the top of the conversation.*
codes.loop.missing_prompt: ⚠️ Add what to run after the interval, for example `/loop 5m check the build`.
codes.loop.interval_too_short: ⚠️ A repeating task can run at most once every {interval}. Choose a longer interval.
codes.loop.no_interval: ⚠️ That `/loop` command has no interval. Write it as `/loop 5m <prompt>` or `/loop every 10 minutes <prompt>`.
